Silent Reading Log Tracker

Track books, pages, and minutes read during independent/silent reading time — per student, per class.

Paste your class list, one name per line. Saving the roster keeps any existing logs, even for names you remove.

Bulk entry — log today's reading for the whole class at once

One row per student. Book defaults to whatever they logged last time — just fill in "pages read to" for kids continuing their book, and type a new title for anyone starting one. Rows left blank (no pages entered) are skipped.

    Add students and log entries to see a class summary.

    Class reading diet

    How many readers have finished at least one book in each genre. Scarcest first is the book-talk list for Monday; most-read first is what the class already reaches for.

    Genre spread

    Distinct book titles each student has logged in each genre. A zero is the interesting cell — it is a gap in that reader’s diet. Untagged books sit in the last column until a genre is set on them.
    Runs entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded.
